dct_title_s: Democratic Republic of the Congo - Flood on Apr 15 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[FL-20250415-COD-00](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_fl_events/items?eventid=FL-20250415-COD-00) A flood occurred on Apr 15 2025 in Congo, The Democratic Republic of the. It affected an estimated 182007 people and 2603 ha of cropland. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
